description: What Georgia Commons holds, computed now. `collections` is every collection in one row (documents, bodies, places, dates) and is never paged. `entries` is the detail, one row per source, type, and issuing body, largest first, `limit` at a time (`total_entries`, `next_offset`): narrow it with filters (doc_type, level, body_type, body, or a place) to list a place's bodies or a kind of body. Also how much is searchable by meaning, the last update, the qualifications, and what is not held yet (county governments, local bodies beyond the ones held, the Court of Appeals).

Filters.description: Hard filters. Every field is optional; values come from the vocabularies.

action.description: Stage of an action inside a meeting: reading, motion, vote, adopted, failed, public_comment, ...
action.title: Action

body.description: Issuing bodies by id, e.g. ga-supreme-court, ga-senate, ga-house-rules, savannah-city-council (describe_site lists the state's; get_coverage with a place lists a place's).
body.title: Body

body_type.description: Kinds of body: legislative_chamber, legislative_committee, court, board_of_education, governing_body, ...
body_type.title: Body Type

county_fips.description: A Georgia Civic Data county key (5 digits, e.g. 13051 for Chatham): documents issued for that county, or for the consolidated government that is it.
county_fips.title: County Fips

date_field.description: Which date the range applies to; defaults to each type's own (filing date for opinions, meeting date for meetings).
date_field.title: Date Field

date_from.description: Earliest date: YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD.
date_from.title: Date From

date_to.description: Latest date: YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD.
date_to.title: Date To

district_code.description: A Georgia Civic Data school district key (the state's code, e.g. 625): documents issued for that school district.
district_code.title: District Code

doc_type.description: Document types: bill, amendment, opinion, code_section, constitution_provision, meeting_transcript (House and Senate meetings), meeting_minutes (local boards' minutes). describe_site lists every type that holds documents.
doc_type.title: Doc Type

include_overlapping.description: With place: also bodies whose area overlaps it (Fulton and DeKalb for Atlanta).
include_overlapping.title: Include Overlapping

level.description: Levels of government: federal, state, county, municipal, consolidated, school_district, regional; `local` means every level below the state.
level.title: Level

place.description: A Georgia place in words or as an id (Atlanta, Cobb County, city:savannah): the documents of that place's governments, and state documents that mention it (place_scope changes this).
place.title: Place

place_fips.description: A Georgia Civic Data place key (7 digits, e.g. 1369000 for Savannah): documents issued for that city, town, or consolidated government.
place_fips.title: Place Fips

place_scope.description: With place: auto (default) is the documents of that place's governments plus state documents that mention it; jurisdiction is only its governments' documents; mentions is any document that mentions it, another local government's included; either is jurisdiction or mentions.
place_scope.title: Place Scope

status.description: Status classes: pending, passed_one_chamber, passed_both, enacted, vetoed, failed, in_force, repealed, decided, held.
status.title: Status

Filters.title: Filters

filters.description: Optional: narrow to document types, levels (local: every level below the state), kinds of body, bodies, or a place (place, place_fips, county_fips, district_code). Other filter fields are not used here.

limit.description: Detail rows to return (one per source, type, and body), largest first: 1 to 200.
limit.title: Limit

offset.description: Detail rows to skip: the next_offset of the previous call.
offset.title: Offset

name: get_coverage
title: What Georgia Commons holds
